body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure all our core repos have auto release non pre release.' New release job in ci.yml, gated on push to main, reuses the existing client+server build zips, auto-bumps MINOR version only (major stays a human call), creates a real (non-prerelease) GitHub release. REDGARDEN e8bb820.

⚓ ☃
title: Auto-release CI, matching PITVIPER's pattern (non-prerelease, auto minor-version bump)
